shared_elements: low-relief carving on an upright stone slab
arms and hands with fingers rendered in relief
horizontal register bands dividing the surface
repeated small motifs in a row
bird-like/animal head in profile (A) vs winged-attendant style heads (B)
justification: Both are low-relief carvings organised in horizontal registers with figures in profile and some repeated small motifs, but that is about as generic as relief iconography gets. A shows a stack of animalsas a bird-headed creature, quadrupeds, a bird with a snake-like body, and rows of abstract signs \shows large naturalistically proportioned human figures in long fringed garments holding a staff and a bowl, an entirely different subject and stylistic convention (schematic zoomorphic vs naturalistic anthropomorphic).
